text: Managing a team well requires several important skills. First, clear communication is essential, so everyone understands their tasks and goals. A good manager also knows how to delegate work effectively, giving each person responsibilities that match their strengths. Providing regular feedback helps team members improve and feel valued. Motivation is another key factor, as happy employees work harder and stay longer. Finally, when disagreements happen, a manager must handle conflict resolution calmly and fairly. By combining these skills, a strong leader can build a successful team where people trust each other and work together towards shared goals.
